sql:
SELECT
  c.created_at::date AS cart_date,
  COUNT(*) AS carts_created,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.status = 'converted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS overall_conversion_pct,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.status = 'converted' AND c.converted_at IS NOT NULL AND c.converted_at <= c.created_at + INTERVAL '1 hour' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_converted_within_1_hour
FROM carts c
JOIN tenants t ON t.id = c.tenant_id
WHERE t.name = 'Cragsley Outfitters'
  AND c.created_at >= DATE '2025-11-17'
  AND c.created_at < DATE '2025-12-02'
GROUP BY c.created_at::date
ORDER BY cart_date ASC
note: Conversion = cart status 'converted'; within-1-hour = converted_at minus created_at <= 1 hour, matching the standard cart-conversion definitions used in prior weekly reports. 15 rows expected (Nov 17 - Dec 1 2025), one per day, no truncation.
